-- Migración: Sistema de Evaluación de Desempeño 360°
-- Fecha: 2026-02-24

-- Tabla de ciclos de evaluación 360°
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evaluation_360_cycles` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `cycle_name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` TEXT,
  `start_date` DATE NOT NULL,
  `end_date` DATE NOT NULL,
  `status` ENUM('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `created_by` INT NOT NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_cycle_status` (`status`),
  INDEX `idx_cycle_dates` (`start_date`, `end_date`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabla de asignaciones de empleados a ciclos
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evaluation_360_assignments` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `cycle_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `evaluated_employee_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `status` ENUM('pending', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `completion_date` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_assignment_cycle` (`cycle_id`),
  INDEX `idx_assignment_employee` (`evaluated_employee_id`),
  INDEX `idx_assignment_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabla de evaluadores asignados
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evaluation_360_evaluators` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `assignment_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `evaluator_employee_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `evaluator_type` ENUM('self', 'peer', 'supervisor', 'subordinate', 'external') NOT NULL,
  `status` ENUM('pending', 'in_progress', 'completed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `completed_at` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  INDEX `idx_evaluator_assignment` (`assignment_id`),
  INDEX `idx_evaluator_employee` (`evaluator_employee_id`),
  INDEX `idx_evaluator_type` (`evaluator_type`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabla de respuestas de evaluación
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evaluation_360_responses` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `evaluator_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `competency_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `competency_type` ENUM('technical', 'soft_skill', 'leadership', 'organizational') NOT NULL,
  `score` INT NOT NULL CHECK (`score` BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  `comments` TEXT,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_response_evaluator` (`evaluator_id`),
  INDEX `idx_response_competency` (`competency_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabla de resultados consolidados
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evaluation_360_results` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `assignment_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `competency_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `competency_type` ENUM('technical', 'soft_skill', 'leadership', 'organizational') NOT NULL,
  `self_score` DECIMAL(3,2),
  `peer_avg_score` DECIMAL(3,2),
  `supervisor_score` DECIMAL(3,2),
  `subordinate_avg_score` DECIMAL(3,2),
  `overall_avg_score` DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL,
  `gap_self_vs_others` DECIMAL(3,2) COMMENT 'Diferencia entre autoevaluación y evaluación de pares',
  `gap_supervisor_vs_peers` DECIMAL(3,2) COMMENT 'Diferencia entre supervisor y pares',
  `total_evaluators` INT NOT NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_result_assignment` (`assignment_id`),
  INDEX `idx_result_competency` (`competency_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabla de planes de desarrollo individual (IDP)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evaluation_360_development_plans` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `assignment_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `strengths` JSON COMMENT 'Competencias con score >= 4.0',
  `improvement_areas` JSON COMMENT 'Competencias con score < 3.0',
  `action_items` JSON COMMENT 'Acciones de desarrollo específicas',
  `status` ENUM('draft', 'approved', 'in_progress', 'completed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_plan_employee` (`employee_id`),
  INDEX `idx_plan_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
